the Holy Land: Every year, thousands of Christians travel to the Holy Land to visit the places where Jesus once lived.
每年有數千名基督徒前往聖地，參訪耶穌曾經生活過的地方。
holy water: At the church, the priest sprinkled holy water on the baby's head during the ceremony.
在教堂裡，神父於儀式中把聖水灑在嬰兒頭上。
a holy war: The leader called the fight a holy war, claiming that God was on his side.
那位領袖稱這場戰鬥為聖戰，聲稱上帝站在他那一邊。
holier-than-thou: Nobody likes Peter's holier-than-thou attitude; he acts as if he never makes mistakes himself.
沒有人喜歡彼得那副自以為清高的態度；他表現得好像自己從不犯錯。
feel homesick: During her first month at college in Tainan, Lily would often feel homesick and call her parents every night.
在台南讀大學的第一個月，莉莉常常想家，每晚都打電話給爸媽。
be homesick for Taiwan: After a year of studying in Canada, Jason began to be homesick for Taiwan and its night markets.
在加拿大讀書一年後，傑森開始想念台灣和那裡的夜市。
get homesick: Many exchange students get homesick when they miss their family and their mother's cooking.
許多交換學生想念家人和媽媽煮的菜時，就會開始想家。
an honorable discharge: After serving in the army for ten years, he received an honorable discharge and returned home a hero.
在陸軍服役十年後，他光榮退伍，以英雄之姿返鄉。
do the honorable thing: After the scandal became public, the minister decided to do the honorable thing and resign at once.
醜聞曝光後，部長決定做體面正當的事，立刻辭職。
an honorable mention: Although she didn't win first prize, Mia's painting received an honorable mention in the national art contest.
雖然沒有得到首獎，米亞的畫作在全國美術比賽中獲得佳作獎。
the Honorable Judge: The lawyer bowed slightly to the Honorable Judge before showing the court the new evidence.
律師在向法庭出示新證據之前，先向法官大人微微鞠躬。
a horizontal line: The teacher drew a horizontal line across the board and asked us to write our answers below it.
老師在黑板上畫了一條水平線，要我們把答案寫在線的下面。
horizontal integration: Through horizontal integration, the coffee chain bought several smaller coffee shops to reduce competition.
透過水平整合，那家咖啡連鎖店買下了幾家較小的咖啡店以減少競爭。
horizontal stripes: People say that clothes with horizontal stripes can make you look wider than you really are.
人們說，有橫條紋的衣服會讓你看起來比實際上更寬。
a horrible mistake: Sending that angry email to my boss was a horrible mistake that almost cost me my job.
寄那封氣憤的電子郵件給老闆是個可怕的錯誤，差點讓我丟了工作。
a horrible feeling: I had a horrible feeling in my stomach when I realized I had left my passport at home.
當我發現把護照留在家裡時，我的胃裡有一種非常不舒服的感覺。
be horrible to someone: It was wrong of the older students to be horrible to the new boy just because he spoke differently.
高年級學生只因新來的男孩說話方式不同就對他很惡劣，這是不對的。
be hostile to change: Some older workers tend to be hostile to change and refuse to learn the new computer system.
有些年長員工往往反對改變，拒絕學習新的電腦系統。
a hostile environment: Bullying in the office created a hostile environment, and many employees were afraid to come to work.
辦公室裡的霸凌造成了充滿敵意的環境，許多員工都害怕來上班。
a hostile takeover: The small company tried hard to avoid a hostile takeover by the giant firm that wanted to control it.
那家小公司努力避免被想控制它的大企業惡意併購。
hostile forces: The soldiers crossed the mountains at night so that hostile forces would not see them coming.
士兵們趁夜越過山區，以免被敵軍發現他們的到來。
a hostile reception: The new coach got a hostile reception from fans, who booed him loudly when he walked onto the field.
新教練受到球迷充滿敵意的接待，他一走上球場就被大聲噓。
hourly workers: At the fast-food restaurant, hourly workers are paid only for the time they actually spend on the job.
在速食店，計時人員只按照實際工作的時間領薪水。
hourly updates: During the typhoon, the weather bureau gave hourly updates so people knew where the storm was heading.
颱風期間，氣象局每小時更新資訊，讓民眾知道颱風往哪裡移動。
hot and humid: Summer in Taipei is hot and humid, so my shirt is wet with sweat after just a short walk.
台北的夏天又熱又濕，所以我只走一小段路，襯衫就被汗水濕透了。
a humid climate: In a humid climate like Taiwan's, wet clothes take a long time to dry and mold grows easily.
在像台灣這樣潮濕的氣候中，濕衣服要很久才會乾，而且容易發霉。
high humidity: Because of the high humidity in the rainy season, the walls of our bathroom are always damp.
由於雨季濕度高，我們浴室的牆壁總是潮潮的。
a humorous remark: The speaker made a humorous remark about his own bad singing, and the whole audience burst out laughing.
講者對自己很爛的歌聲說了一句幽默的話，全場觀眾都笑了出來。
a humorous look at: The new comedy show takes a humorous look at the daily life of high school students and their exams.
這個新的喜劇節目以幽默的角度看高中生的日常生活和考試。
